policy_allow.note: Policy allowed the action outright. No human was involved and no disposition is claimed.

human_approved_at_escalation.note: A person wrote the decision file during the approvals handshake. A human acted on THIS action.

replayed_prior_approval.note: find_prior_approval matched an earlier resolution inside its 24h window. The allow replays a human decision taken on a DIFFERENT action, so no human acted on this one.

human_reviewed_but_policy_disposed.note: A human looked at it and the disposition was still automatic. Legal: the flag only ever narrows the claim.

policy_claiming_human.note: The lie this vocabulary exists to prevent.

unknown_approver.note: The vocabulary is closed. counterparty is a value another specification uses and this one does not.

truthy_non_bool_flag.note: A caller passing 1 rather than True must not silently produce a human claim.
